item.title: CNV Update Prerequisites
item.description: Version compatibility, channel selection, and pre-update verification. Version Compatibility OpenShift Virtualization version must be compatible with the OpenShift Container Platform version. General Rule OpenShift Version CNV Version Channel 4.15 4.15.x stable-4.15 4.16 4.16.x stable-4.16 4.17 4.17.x stable-4.17 4.18 4.18.x stable-4.18 Note: CNV versions align with OpenShift minor versions. CNV 4.17 runs on OpenShift 4.17.
